# starcreates

> starcreates is a Roblox game development and publishing company led by co-founders and CEOs Theo Evans and Elliot Askew. It develops and operates its own Roblox experiences, including Build or Die and +1 ASMR Keyboard Destruction, and partners with, invests in and acquires Roblox games from other developers.

## Key facts

- Website: https://starcreates.org
- Industry: Roblox game development, publishing, investment and acquisitions
- Over 2 million play sessions across all starcreates games
- More than 342,000 players and around 24,500 monthly active users
- Contact: hello@starcreates.org, @starcreates_dev on X
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/starcreates/

## Leadership

- Theo Evans (@infirmn), Co-Founder & CEO: Roblox game developer and software engineer with 7+ years of experience building large-scale Roblox experiences and complex game systems. Has contributed to Roblox games that have collectively surpassed 4 billion play sessions, and was invited to the Roblox Developers Conference (RDC) 2025 and 2026. Leads development and acquisitions. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/theo-at-starcreates/
- Elliot Askew (@ESGaminggg), Co-Founder & CEO: leads company growth, manages development across all projects and builds the community. Also a content creator and video editor whose YouTube channels have tens of thousands of subscribers and millions of combined views. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/elliot-askew/

## Games

- Build or Die: 2M+ visits, 25,900+ favourites, 84,300+ likes, peak of 724 concurrent players
- [+1 ASMR Keyboard Destruction](https://www.roblox.com/games/87361386694346): 59,800+ visits, 2,300+ favourites, peak of 378 concurrent players
- A new, larger project is in development

- [Home](https://starcreates.org/): about the company, stats, founders, FAQ and contact
